audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Riven wins Level 1 and 2+ items; the packet chart says Skill at Level 1 and Urgot at 2+ items, and the prose (early, whys[6], late) already says Level 1 is neutral and 2-item Urgot wins the grind.
audit.why: 48.85% winRate over 1091 games with a losing late game; both layers disagreed with the packet and with their own why-text.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill, 2+ items -> Urgot, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 2-3 (W + full pattern), Lvl 6 (Blade of the Exile), 1st item, 2+ items; all four entries present and ordered.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Wind Slash 'executes him the moment he drops to the Fear Beyond Death execute threshold' — Fear Beyond Death is Urgot's own execute threshold and has nothing to do with Riven's R. Wind Slash is also a projectile with no interaction stated.
audit.why: Kit text: Riven R grants AD/range and one ranged Wind Slash (projectile flag); Urgot R impales and executes below a threshold. Conflating the two invents a mechanic.
audit.corrected: Wind Slash scales with the target's missing health and is a projectile; fire it before Disdain (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) repositions you. Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s) and the third-Q knockback are the tools that break up Purge's point-blank window.

audit.why: Disdain at 14-16s is correctly named as the punishable cooldown throughout.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: your Q resets weave autos, but Echoing Flames answers every auto he lands. Farm at Q's tip and commit nothing yet.

edits.before: Level 1 Urgot procs Echoing Flames on every auto-reset — stand just outside his auto range to farm and deny free leg stacks.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: Echoing Flames fires off his autos, so farm from Q's 275 range and deny him the free leg procs on you.

edits.before: Full Q-W-Q-E-Q pattern bursts him faster than his percent-HP legs cycle back; the stun window is everything, execute the rotation cleanly.
edits.after: Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) locks him for the whole Q chain and the third-Q knockback shoves him off you — burst, then leave before Purge restarts.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and Wind Slash executes him the moment he drops to the Fear Beyond Death execute threshold — force the all-in before he can flip you.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your range and Wind Slash hits hardest as he drops low, but it is a projectile — fire it before Disdain (14-16s) flips you out of position and into Purge.

notes: Full-layer prose strings in this matchup contain mojibake em dashes (a-hat sequences) on disk; I only edited full-layer strings that are clean ASCII so no before-mismatch is possible. The mojibake itself should be fixed by a repo-wide encoding pass, not per-matchup. Level-chart flips proposed as two matched full/content pairs plus the Level 1 rating.
